text: Building a mobile app is an exciting process, but it involves several important decisions. One of the first choices is whether to go native or cross-platform. Native apps are built specifically for iOS or Android, giving better performance and smooth access to device features. Cross-platform tools, however, allow you to write one codebase for both systems, which saves time and money. Regardless of your choice, responsive design is essential—your interface must look and work well on different screen sizes. Before launch, you also need to consider app stores, as each has its own guidelines and approval process. Finally, always test for performance, because users quickly abandon apps that are slow or crash often.
